guarantees.claim: initiated is cleared to 1'b0 when reset (rst_ni low)
initiated is set to 1'b1 on hash_start_or_continue assertion, regardless of hash_process or reg_hash_stop
initiated is cleared to 1'b0 when hash_process or reg_hash_stop is asserted and hash_start_or_continue is not active
initiated holds its current value when no condition triggers (no reset, no start, no process/stop)

assumptions.claim: External logic must not assert hash_start_or_continue simultaneously with hash_process or reg_hash_stop if the intent is to clear initiated, because the start condition takes priority and keeps initiated high
assumptions.cond: hash_start_or_continue concurrently with hash_process or reg_hash_stop
assumptions.risk: initiated remains 1, hash core may not enter the expected state, leading to control mismatch

uncertain_points.claim: initiated is not cleared on error conditions. If an error occurs while initiated is high and neither hash_process nor reg_hash_stop is later asserted, initiated will remain high indefinitely, potentially stalling the hash engine or preventing recovery
uncertain_points.cond: any error event without subsequent hash_process or reg_hash_stop
uncertain_points.risk: hash engine stuck in initiated state, blocking new operations or causing security monitor failure

uncertain_points.claim: initiated transitions to 0 when hash_process or reg_hash_stop asserts. If the hash core still needs initiated high for internal handshake completion, premature clearing could cause state inconsistency.
uncertain_points.cond: hash_process or reg_hash_stop asserted before internal operation fully finishes
uncertain_points.risk: initiated deasserted too early, desynchronizing from downstream logic relying on it
